_note: INVARIANTS rule 1 ratchet, seeded 2026-10-15 (build section 72, lineage_lint.py). Every entry is a node that reaches a DELIVERY node and fails one of the four checks: "lineage" it composes a document a customer receives without carrying v5/code/_lineage.js; "evidence" it hands on findings without running LN.evidenced; "like_for_like" it subtracts a stored earlier report figure without checking the report type and the sample size; "withheld" it shows a score with no path that withholds it when an input is unavailable. The lint fails the build on anything NOT listed here, so this debt cannot grow, and a node that gains its guard is dropped from the list for ever and can never come back. Five of these are real defects, named here as B-L1..B-L5 for the register (FIX_PLAN.md) rather than excused; the row in the register is the orchestrator's to add. Two debts the same inventory found were PAID in section 72 and are deliberately absent: the audit's seven site-wide findings that shipped with an empty evidence string, and the technical site audit that had no "Where these numbers come from" table at all. What this ratchet does NOT say: that every individual figure inside a node that passes carries its own lineage. LN.of() proves the node was built to say where a number came from, never that the number beside it did. PAID AND GONE FOR EVER (build section 73, 2026-10-15): B-L1 Blog Package, B-L2 Build Keyword Strategy, B-L3 Build Word File, B-L4 AI Metrics and B-L5 Parse Backlinks each gained the guard they were listed for and left this file; the ratchet cannot let them back in. Two weaknesses in the lint itself were found while paying them and are fixed in lineage_lint.py: a kit HEADER that names the call the lint looks for (_lineage.js says "LN.block() prints the whole list") answered the lint's question for every node that merely carried the kit, so comments are now stripped before every check; and a node that RENDERS lineage composed upstream (Site Report prints the list Site Metrics builds) is a use of the kit, not a gap. CHECK E "refusal" ADDED 2026-10-15 (build section 76, FIX_PLAN §3.16 B-A11): every node that reads a `<X> Answers` node -- the output of rule 3's in-200 retry gate, which attaches RT.evidence to every item as __dfs -- must carry a way of saying it could not be read, because rule 3 ends "nothing downstream may score, rank or advise from `unavailable` evidence" and until now nothing checked the second half of that sentence. 33 nodes are in the class; Pick Competitors, Competitor Analysis and Analyze Keywords were fixed in the same section and are deliberately absent; the 19 listed here are the debt, each with its own reason, split between request builders (they ask for less when less was read and derive nothing) and nodes that do derive a figure and are real debt of the same class.
